source: GitHub resolves an owner and a repository name in any case to one repository: git ls-remote on github.com/safedep/dry, github.com/SafeDep/DRY and github.com/SAFEDEP/Dry returned one HEAD on 2026-10-15. The PURL spec says github names are not case sensitive. A git ref is case sensitive, so the version stays raw. The path in the repository is a directory in the git tree and keeps its case: raw.githubusercontent.com/actions/cache/v4/save/action.yml returned 200 and .../v4/Save/action.yml returned 404 on 2026-10-15, while .../Actions/Cache/v4/save/action.yml returned 200.
